title: 第7章 往事如烟柔情校花第8章 一目十行过目不忘
lines: 翌日。
天还没亮唐明就起床，在陈家院子里活络筋骨。
虽说练成了青冥神瞳，可修炼时日尚浅，他被挑断的脚筋还需要慢慢恢复。
“应该快了，我有木灵精滋养体魄，不出三天就能痊愈。”
唐明内心暗忖。
锻炼了一个小时，柳姨他们也都陆续起床，准备吃早餐。
陈志刚拿出手机看新闻，突然皱眉：“咦，昨晚上青湖公园发生了命案，有几名亡命之徒，被警察击毙了。”
“真的假的，青湖公园离我们可没多远。”柳姨有些担忧。
“都上新闻了，你看这。”
陈志刚把手机转过来：“都是通缉犯，专门流窜在华南几个省的惯犯，幸亏被击毙了。”
“我说呢，最近中海交通管制严查车辆，原来是在围剿通缉犯。”
唐明内心一动，青湖公园命案，不就是昨晚那件事吗？
幸好，那个美女警官还算理智，没有把他报告出来，要不然会多出很多不必要的麻烦。
吃完早饭。
柳姨本来要亲自送唐明去学校，可接到公司通知有重要会议，只好让陈思琪带唐明去。
半小时后，两人来到第一附中校门口。
“思琪。”
“思琪，这边。”
三名穿校服的青春美少女，在街头挥舞着小手。
这几人都算是美女级别，尤其是其中一个扎着马尾的少女，明眸皓齿，皮肤白皙，精致脸蛋上不施粉黛，却也美艳动人。
相比下。
另外两个女生就差了些许，画着淡妆，涂着指甲油，还带着奢华名贵的首饰。
“雯雯，你这是要造反啊。”
陈思琪看到闺蜜的打扮，惊愕道：“你敢这样去班级？就不怕班主任把你家长叫过来。”
“怕什么，马上快毕业了。”
名叫雯雯的少女笑嘻嘻道：“再说了，买了好东西不拿出来炫耀炫耀，我还不如不买呢，年轻，就是要炫耀。”
“啧啧，这一身得要好几十万，你家真有钱。”
陈思琪羡慕非凡。
田雯雯得到闺蜜的夸奖很是得意，随后看到后面的唐明，皱着眉头嫌弃：“思琪，这就是你说的远方亲戚？”
“也太寒酸了吧，你看看他，身上都是地摊货，鞋子洗得发白了，不过长得还算眉清目秀，但和我家赵鹏比差远了。”
赵鹏，是她男朋友，是个家里有钱有势的富二代。
“行行行，你家赵鹏最优秀，非要在我们面前秀恩爱。”
“走吧，快上课了。”
陈思琪抱着田雯雯和高个女生的手，边走边聊，聊的都是关于田雯雯身上的奢侈品。
马尾少女在后边跟随，显然对奢侈品不感兴趣。
唐明落在最后面。
马尾少女扭头，礼貌微笑：“同学你好，我叫苏雨柔，是陈思琪的好朋友。”
“你好，我叫唐明。”
唐明笑着打招呼，看向苏雨柔的目光有些异样。
“怎么，我们之前见过面吗？”
苏雨柔疑惑开口。
“如果我说上辈子见过你，你信吗？”唐明淡笑开口。
苏雨柔揶揄笑道：“你真会开玩笑，该不会以为我是爱看脑残剧那种女生吧？”
content_en:
The next day.
Tang Ming got up before dawn and stretched his muscles in the Chen family yard.
Although he had mastered the Qingming Divine Eyes, the training time was still short, and his severed hamstring still needed to be slowly recovered.
"It should be soon. I have wood spirit essence to nourish my body and I will be healed in less than three days."
Tang Ming thought to himself.
After exercising for an hour, Aunt Liu and the others got up one after another and prepared to have breakfast.
Chen Zhigang took out his mobile phone to watch the news and suddenly frowned: "Hey, there was a murder in Qinghu Park last night. Several desperadoes were shot dead by the police."
"Really or not, Qinghu Park is not far from us." Aunt Liu was a little worried.
"It's all on the news, look at this."
Chen Zhigang turned the phone over: "They are all wanted criminals, habitual criminals who specialize in several provinces in southern China. Fortunately, they were killed."
"Let me tell you, China Shipping Traffic Control has been strictly checking vehicles recently. It turns out that they are encircling and suppressing wanted criminals."
Tang Ming's heart moved. Wasn't the murder in Qinghu Park the same thing as last night?
Fortunately, the beautiful police officer was still sensible and did not report him, otherwise it would have caused a lot of unnecessary trouble.
…
After breakfast.
Aunt Liu originally wanted to take Tang Ming to school in person, but when she received a notice from the company that there was an important meeting, she had to ask Chen Siqi to take Tang Ming there.
Half an hour later, the two arrived at the gate of the No. 1 High School Affiliated.
"Siqi."
"Siqi, this way."
Three beautiful young girls in school uniforms waved their little hands on the street.
These people are all considered beauties, especially one of them, a girl with a ponytail. She has bright eyes, white teeth, fair skin, and a delicate face that is beautiful even without makeup.
In comparison.
The other two girls were a little worse, wearing light makeup, nail polish, and luxurious jewelry.
"Wenwen, you are going to rebel."
Chen Siqi saw her best friend's dress and said in shock: "How dare you go to class like this? You're not afraid that the head teacher will call your parents over."
"What are you afraid of? I will graduate soon."
The girl named Wenwen said with a smile: "Besides, if you don't show off the good things you bought, I might as well not buy them. Being young means showing off."
"Tsk tsk, this outfit costs hundreds of thousands. Your family is really rich."
Chen Siqi is envious of the extraordinary.
Tian Wenwen was very proud to receive the praise from her best friend. Then she saw Tang Ming behind her and frowned in disgust: "Siqi, is this the distant relative you mentioned?"
"It's too shabby. Look at him. He's covered in street stall goods and his shoes have turned white after being washed. He's pretty handsome, but he's nowhere near as good as my Zhao Peng."
Zhao Peng is her boyfriend, a rich second generation from a rich and powerful family.
"Okay, okay, your Zhao Peng is the best. He must show his love in front of us."
"Let's go, class is about to start."
Chen Siqi held the hands of Tian Wenwen and the tall girl, and talked while walking, all about Tian Wenwen's luxury goods.
The girl with ponytail followed behind, obviously not interested in luxury goods.
Tang Ming fell at the end.
The ponytail girl turned her head and smiled politely: "Hello, classmate, my name is Su Yurou, and I am Chen Siqi's good friend."
"Hello, my name is Tang Ming."
Tang Ming greeted with a smile and looked at Su Yurou with a strange look.
"What, have we met before?"
Su Yurou spoke in confusion.
"If I said I met you in my previous life, would you believe it?" Tang Ming said with a faint smile.
Su Yurou teased and said, "You are really good at joking. Don't you think I'm the kind of girl who likes to watch stupid dramas?"
title_en: Chapter 7 The past is like smoke, the tender school beauty Chapter 8 One glance and ten lines are unforgettable
